notes.title: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul Demo Released!
notes.content:
👋  Exciting news everyone! 

We are really happy to announce the release of the demo of our latest adventure game "Alchemist: Journey of the Soul"! 

We have been working on it for quite some time now and we can finally share it with you, in order to get your precious feedback!

You can wishlist ❤️  the game and play the demo here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115240?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=DEMOannouncement

Thank you,
OnSkull Games

notes.title: Optimization patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As we continue working on the full game, we are optimizing code and assets. This results in performance gains that can also be brought to the prologue/demo version. We have just pushed an update that should improve performance by ~25%!

Thank you all for your feedback,
    OnSkull Games
